treaty_name: Convention between Malta and Sweden for the Avoidance of Double Taxation and the Prevention of Fiscal Evasion with respect to Taxes on Income (1995)
source_title: S.L. 123.38 Double Taxation Relief on Taxes on Income with the Kingdom of Sweden Order (Schedule: 1995 Convention and Protocol)

rates.quote: However, if the beneficial owner is a company which holds at least 10 per cent of the voting power of the company paying the dividends, the dividends shall be exempt from tax in Sweden.

Where the dividends are paid by a company which is a resident of Sweden to a resident of Malta who is the beneficial owner thereof, the Swedish tax so charged shall not exceed 15 per cent of the gross amount of the dividends.
Interest arising in a Contracting State and paid to a resident of the other Contracting State shall be taxable only in that other State, if such resident is the beneficial owner of the interest.
Royalties arising in a Contracting State and paid to a resident of the other Contracting State shall be taxable only in that other State if such resident is the beneficial owner of the royalties.

ppt.basis: n/a - MLI not yet in effect (Sweden Art. 35(7)(a) reservation, no 35(7)(b) notification for Malta); no treaty PPT

notes: Effective in Sweden for income derived from 1 Jan following EIF (Art. 28(2)(a)) -> 1997-01-01. EIF: Malta's MLI list gives 03-02-1996; Sweden's MLI list gives 09-02-1996 with a footnote that Malta considers 03-02-1996 (both give the same effective date). Swedish 0% tier: company holding >=10% of voting power (no holding period). Malta-source dividends (Art. 10(2)(b)(i)): Malta tax 'shall not exceed that chargeable on the profits out of which the dividends are paid' - no fixed percentage, not modelled; 10(2)(b)(ii) 15% for industrial-aid companies applied only for the first ten years. Replaced the 1975 Agreement. MLI: both list the treaty, but Sweden reserved Art. 35(7)(a) and per the merged dataset (OECD status) has not notified completion for Malta, so MLI provisions incl. the PPT are not yet in effect.
unverified: absence of a Swedish 35(7)(b) notification for Malta relies on the merged dataset
